applicationEvidence.detail: GridLineWidth follows LineWidth in auto mode, and MinorGridLineWidth follows GridLineWidth in auto mode. Explicit grid-width setters select manual mode; a manual receiver holds its current getter. Initialize upstream widths before downstream values and restore requested final modes.
